caption: Post-Night 3 minigame: the 'Fredbear & Friends! 1983' broadcast on the house TV.
Post-Night 5 minigame: the crying child surrounded by his Foxy-masked older brother and three masked friends at the party.
Post-Night 2 minigame: a purple figure fits a Spring Bonnie head onto another person in the diner's back room.
Nightmare (Night 7) ending: the padlocked box — 'Perhaps some things are best left forgotten, for now.'
Post-Night 4 minigame: the child locked in the parts room with Fredbear and Spring Bonnie heads on the shelves.
Rare bedroom variant: an IV drip beside the bed.
FNaF World clock ending: 'The pieces are in place for you.'
Custom Night final walking cutscene: the purple man about to eject Ennard (first frame, 3x nearest-neighbour upscale).
Circus Baby's minigame: the claw extending from Baby's stomach (single frame, 2x upscale).
Real Ending: the silhouette in the mirror opens purple animatronic eyes (final frame).
